name: HEDISCoreExplanationOfBenefitInpatientInstitutional
title: HEDIS Core ExplanationOfBenefit Inpatient Institutional
description: The HEDIS Core ExplanationOfBenefit Inpatient Institutional profile extends CARIN for Blue Button® to include requirements for measure calculation.

constraint.human: Where Admission Type and Point of Origin slices exist, if Type of Admission code is Newborn, Point of Origin must be from Point of Origin - Newborn CodeSystem  or Type of Admission is not Newborn and Point of Origin must be from Point of Origin Nonnewborn CodeSystem.
constraint.expression: (supportingInfo.where(code.coding.system = 'https://www.nubc.org/CodeSystem/PriorityTypeOfAdmitOrVisit' and code.coding.code = '4').exists() and supportingInfo.where(code.coding.system='AHANUBCPointOfOriginForAdmissionOrVisitNonnewborn').exists()).not() and (supportingInfo.where(code.coding.system = 'https://www.nubc.org/CodeSystem/PriorityTypeOfAdmitOrVisit' and code.coding.code != '4').exists() and supportingInfo.where(code.coding.system = 'https://www.nubc.org/CodeSystem/PointOfOriginNewborn').exists() ).not()

constraint.human: Institutional EOB: Careteam roles refer to a practitioner
constraint.expression: ( role.where(coding.where(code in ('attending' | 'primary' | 'referring' | 'supervisor')).exists()).exists() implies provider.all(resolve() is Practitioner) )

constraint.human: Institutional EOB:  Careteam roles refer to an organization
constraint.expression: ( role.where(coding.where(code in ('performing' )).exists()).exists() implies provider.all(resolve() is Organization) )
